design_notes: Use hairline rules to separate the financials table and the sidebar; accent colour for the pull-quote rule and the industry snapshot stat values.
Set the financials table in a serif face with right-aligned numerals; the sidebar in a slightly smaller serif with a light rule above.
The industry snapshot stat strip should sit between the market paragraph and the competition paragraph, with the three numbers in the accent colour.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: The market is the infrastructure and construction sector
industry_snapshot.rationale: Three headline market figures from the filing give the reader a quick sense of the sector's scale and growth.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Revenue is won through a disclosed tender process
pull_quotes.quote: Western Railway alone is 52% of the order book.
pull_quotes.rationale: A single, sharp concentration figure that the prose cannot carry as effectively.

sidebars.body_markdown: The issue comprises 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 each at a price to be determined.[^drhp-p29] The lead manager is Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited; the registrar is Bigshare Services Private Limited.[^drhp-p31] Proceeds are earmarked for working capital (₹1,130 lakh) and general corporate purposes.[^drhp-p48] No offer-for-sale is disclosed.[^drhp-p29]
sidebars.rationale: Condenses the offer mechanics into a scannable sidebar, freeing the prose for analysis.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: The restated statements run from FY2014 to FY2018.
tables.rationale: The five-year restated financials are the core of the report; a table lets the reader see the revenue decline and profit spike at a glance.
tables.title: Restated financial summary, FY2014–FY2018

tables.after_paragraph: Because the labels for these values are not in the extract
tables.footnote: Source: DRHP pages 54, 55. The row labels are not identified in the extract; the values cannot be attributed to a specific ratio.[^drhp-p54][^drhp-p55]
tables.rationale: The filing's own valuation metrics are unlabelled; a table presents them honestly without inventing labels.
tables.title: Disclosed basis-of-issue metrics, FY2016–FY2018
